name: stasis_snare_flash_on_opponents_turn
notes: P50a878933a G4. Printed: 'Flash' and 'When this enchantment enters, exile target creature an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.' On seat 1's turn (turn 2), seat 0 casts Stasis Snare ({1}{W}{W}) at instant speed; it resolves and enters, and its trigger exiles seat 1's Wolf (seat 0's own Bear is not touched).
